title: Optimization of a Hybrid Solar-Biogas-Battery Energy Storage Microgrid: A Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.33593v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-income regions like eastern Uganda often lack reliable grid power. This paper presents the techno-economic optimization of the Soroti Integrated Renewable Energy Microgrid (SIREM), a hybrid renewable system for grid-access expansion where Soroti District household grid access stands at 16.7\%. The microgrid integrates concentrating solar power (CSP) with thermal storage, biogas combined cycle generation, and lithium iron phosphate battery storage. Using Xendee optimization software with six years of NASA POWER data, the optimal configuration comprises a 37 MW CSP field, 70 MWh molten-salt storage, a 5 MW CSP turbine, a 6 MW biogas CCGT, and a 10 MWh battery system. translated_title: 太阳能-沼气-电池储能混合微电网的优化：案例研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33593v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：乌干达东部等低收入地区往往缺乏可靠的电网电力。本文对索罗提综合可再生能源微电网（SIREM）进行了技术经济优化，这是一种用于扩大电网覆盖的混合可再生能源系统，索罗提区的家庭电网接入率仅为16.7%。该微电网集成了带储热的聚光太阳能发电（CSP）、沼气联合循环发电以及磷酸铁锂电池储能。利用Xendee优化软件和六年的NASA POWER数据，最优配置包括37 MW的CSP集热场、70 MWh的熔盐储热系统、5 MW的CSP汽轮机、6 MW的沼气联合循环发电机组（CCGT）以及10 MWh的电池储能系统。该设计每年可供电61.3 GWh，内部收益率（IRR）达42.91%，投资回收期为2年，发电侧平准化电力成本为0.1991美元/千瓦时（负荷侧为0.3752美元/千瓦时），相比仅依赖电网供电可节省32.2%的总成本，同时每年还可外送28.8 GWh电力，展示了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过技术经济优化为乌干达索罗提地区设计出太阳能-沼气-电池混合微电网的最优配置，实现年供电61.3 GWh、42.91%的内部收益率和两年回本，相比纯电网供电节省32.2%的成本，为低收入地区电网扩展提供了可行方案。
en_tdlr: This study presents a techno-economic optimization of a hybrid solar-biogas-battery microgrid in Soroti, Uganda, achieving 61.3 GWh annual supply, 42.91% IRR, 2-year payback, and 32.2% cost savings versus grid-only supply, demonstrating a viable pathway for grid-access expansion in low-income regions.
